engines.help_quickstart:
Create an engine on the “Engines” tab with its endpoint and key
Click “Set as default” so it handles every session
Send /tts_test or just chat to confirm audio comes back
Use the “Bindings” tab to give a specific group its own voice
engines.help_permissions:
· Admin commands are restricted by default
· Turning off admin_only_commands lets everyone run them
· User IDs listed in admin_user_ids are always allowed
· Some platforms also grant access to group or AstrBot admins
· Every command must start with / — without it nothing happens
engines.help_faq:
No audio: check that “Plugin switch”, “AstrBot global TTS” and “Auto synthesis” at the top are all on
Long replies are skipped: the length limit is enabled, adjust it with /tts_limit_set
No voice for code blocks or link-only replies: that's the built-in smart-skip rule, configurable on the “Settings” tab
Only one group is silent: it may be muted with /tts_bind 0 — send /tts_status there
Changes not applied: WebUI edits apply instantly; if the plugin config form was just edited, the page asks you to refresh
